claim_boundary: Synthetic finite deterministic validation only. This result does not validate stochastic recovery, approximate soundness, empirical substrate correctness, value, agency, alignment, or Omega.

families.description: Two binary targets are each recoverable from a declared observation, but neither observation alone recovers the joint target.
The same observation/target pair can be unrecoverable for a weak constant-decoder class and recoverable for a richer Boolean class.
Identity observation refines first-bit observation; every target recoverable from the coarser observation remains recoverable from the finer observation.
First-bit observation is a garbling of identity observation; it recovers a subset of the exact binary targets recoverable from the source observation.
The target-fiber observation recovers the target, and every enumerated observation that recovers the target refines it.
A stale abstraction hides exact reachability loss, while a reflected abstraction that tracks the after-transition does not report the lost path.
